evidence.reason: The finding correctly identifies a real leak in the free-text redaction path. `independentTextUrls` discards a nested scheme hit when it is outside the prior authority/query but the preceding character is not in the prose-delimiter list, so `https://web.archive.org/web/2020/https://u:p@host/` keeps only the outer hit. `redactUrlUserinfo` then checks for `@` only up to the outer URL's authority end, which is before the nested `u:p@host`, leaving the userinfo visible. The `inAuthority`/`inQuery` guards prevent treating schemes inside passwords/queries as separate URLs, but the extra delimiter requirement is not needed for that protection and causes this defect.
